scope: Only the task-context recall queryview in delegated_digital_runner.py and its focused runner regressions. No broader source audit, installation or native quality claim.

sourceAssessment.subject: Relevant context before recall
sourceAssessment.finding: The bound admitted task and newest persisted owner correction are appended before the existing LivingConversation recall reaches the same backend. The original query text is retained; no parallel recall or new storage is introduced.

sourceAssessment.subject: Person and audience binding
sourceAssessment.finding: The wrapper reconstructs the exact existing person/person-project/household/group scope, including the private observation binding. It rejects changed tenant, installation, principal, audience, conversation, project, subject, scope or query purpose before backend dispatch. dataclasses.replace changes only query_text; limits, privacy classes, validity, candidate selection and recall identity are preserved.

sourceAssessment.subject: Original source and authority
sourceAssessment.finding: The original ingress hash and current authorization remain checked before composing the memory view. Neither ConversationTurn nor the canonical grant is modified. Connector actions receive the original turn; retrieval anchors add no action or write authority. Existing memory alias resolution, filtering and returned-fact trust remain in the same backend/model path.

sourceAssessment.subject: Correction history
sourceAssessment.finding: One immutable correction tuple feeds both views: newest correction for retrieval, complete ordered correction history for the existing task model. Earlier owner corrections are not discarded from model context.

sourceAssessment.subject: Fast path and cache
sourceAssessment.finding: Normal recall stays normal, fast recall uses the backend fast method when callable and otherwise the existing normal method once. The unchanged Hindsight cache key includes query text, so a changed task/correction is not mapped to an unrelated cached question.

sourceAssessment.subject: Stop, budget and replay
sourceAssessment.finding: No stop, admission, deadline, output-budget, action receipt or replay code is changed. LivingConversation still checkpoints before initial recall and each step, and the runner still requires the original source and current authorization. Existing verified-action recovery and no-repeat rules remain on the original execution identity.

beforeRegression.observedMissingContext: The query was only the vague original message; admitted task topic was absent.

environmentFailure.repairReportedByImplementer: Install the already runtime-pinned tiktoken 0.14.0 in the local test environment only; no product source change.

focusedRepairRun.coverage: All four previously failing parametrized functions; ten failed cases plus one already passing deadline parameter.

validation.combinedCoverage: All 107 selected cases are covered by passing results across the initial run and focused environment-repaired rerun; no single all-green 107-case run is claimed.
newFeatureChecks: one full runner regression verifies task/latest correction before recall while original turn and model/tool counts are retained
normal and fast backend dispatch with all non-query fields equal
seven mismatched scope/purpose cases reject before backend dispatch
validation.existingCriticalChecks: The selected suite retains stop/revocation, cancellation cleanup, exact release/grant, measured and unknown budgets, verified-effect resume and provider deadline coverage.

qualifications: This is source GO for the exact runner hash, not an installed-runtime or native later-use result.
The full runner regression uses the real conversation loop with controlled memory/model/tools; it proves context delivery, not improved native retrieval ranking or smarter later behavior.
The existing unconfirmed/trust qualifiers and source evidence remain authoritative; search text does not make recalled task outcomes independently verified.
Source/module profile binding must remain exact through packaging and installation; existing grants or persisted task authority must not be expanded.
The full Eva2 project goal, relevant later application, human feedback, full learning cycle, AIDE² and household acceptance remain active/open.
